document_type: ECOS architecture-grouped API reference (not itself an OpenAPI document)

scope.grouping: Every operation appears once under its primary module. Procurement reuses Inventory and Forecasting operations through explicit references; no fictitious procurement router.
scope.authority: openapi_contract is the exact offline app.openapi() export. Operation openapi_ref points to declared parameters, requestBody, responses and reusable components. The architecture grouping, inferred types, auth rules, notes and examples are source-derived documentation, not declared OpenAPI.
scope.example_policy: All supplied payloads, names, IDs, tokens, dates, counts and values are synthetic illustrations, never observed responses. They are independent scenarios, not a single database snapshot. body_ref reuses a complete synthetic payload; multipart file is an illustrative filename, with CSV contents separately documented.
scope.reading_conventions: For each operation, responses contains operation-specific outcomes and shared_errors adds the named entries from error_catalog; operation-specific entries override shared ones. Shared 422 demonstrates the generic declared validation shape, not an assertion that body.items exists on every route. request_example uses path/query/header/body, and body_ref reuses a root synthetic example. openapi_ref resolves the exact declared operation, including all request constraints and declared status schemas.
scope.response_type_caveat: All 42 application success responses are annotated dict and declared as object with additionalProperties=true, with no field-level response models. inferred_types and response inferred_type are descriptive TypeScript-like notation derived from return statements/helpers, not FastAPI guarantees. '?' marks optional fields, '|' a union, '[]' an array, Record<string,T> a mapping. Stored MongoDB documents can add fields.
scope.verification: Run .venv/bin/python scripts/export_api.py. Use --refresh to replace only the embedded declared contract and router source pointers, then review manually curated docs. DNS and socket connections are blocked for imports; no lifespan, route handler or dependency is called. Configuration import may read environment/.env; no configuration or credential values are printed or exported.
limitations: Success example validation against the declared object schema does not prove inferred fields, business invariants or live service behavior.
No live DB/services were queried and backend/smoke_test.py was read, not executed: it starts lifespan, requires MongoDB and drops test collections.

Documented errors include important explicit route/helper failures and shared dependency/exception-handler failures. These are mostly absent from declared OpenAPI; only automatic 422 responses are declared.
Unexpected exceptions can still produce unmodelled 500 responses. No universal JSON 500 contract is promised.
Inferred stored-document shapes vary with seeding, uploads, Qdrant enrichment and model artifacts.
Infrastructure GET/HEAD routes are excluded from application OpenAPI and documented separately; application GET routes do not automatically register HEAD.
Source paths with #L line anchors are repository-relative links. Relative JSON pointers are resolved from this document root.
legacy_documentation_corrections: API_ENDPOINTS.md's 33-operation headline is stale: the actual application has 42 operations.
backend/api.json incorrectly labels GET /users as public; require_manager enforces manager access.
POST /auth/logout does not validate a session and accepts an absent token; it is idempotent public revocation, not a protected session endpoint.
Forecast routes import ml.predictor and ml.train: ML is connected, gated by held-out performance, despite contradictory legacy prose.
Copilot optionally invokes an LLM and includes stock_risk/unknown intents, despite legacy statements that an LLM is not wired.
GET /copilot/suggestions is public. GET /auth/session slides expiry; ordinary current_user authentication does not slide expiry.
Upload row errors return HTTP 200 success=false rather than 422. Parsing/file errors use 400 or 413.

authentication.storage: Password hashes use scrypt; session tokens are hashed in sessions. Login auto-registers unknown IDs as employees; only configured startup provisioning creates the manager.
authentication.expiry: 30 minutes; GET /auth/session validates then extends expiry by 30 minutes. Five incorrect passwords cause a five-minute account lock; the request that establishes the lock returns 401, subsequent attempts while locked return 429.
authentication.openapi_security_caveat: Authentication is represented as ordinary Header parameters/dependencies, not OpenAPI securitySchemes. Role and ownership checks below come from Python source.

policies.user: A valid, unexpired session belonging to an existing user.
policies.manager: Valid session and role=manager; missing/invalid session 401, wrong role 403.
policies.self_or_manager: Valid session; requested user/order owner must match session user unless role=manager.
policies.employee_self: Valid session, role=employee and path user_id equals session user_id.
policies.order_owner: Valid session, order_id belongs to session user, regardless of role; other users' orders appear missing (404).
policies.session_header: Required X-Session-Token (20–100 chars); missing/invalid length is declared 422; unknown/expired token is runtime 401.
policies.public_revoke: Optional X-Session-Token (default empty). Deletes any matching token hash without authenticating; always returns success if DB operation succeeds.

cross_cutting_architecture_gaps.data_layer: Actual operational storage uses synchronous PyMongo, not the diagram's Motor async driver. The menu is recipe inclusion state, not a separate public menus resource.
cross_cutting_architecture_gaps.background_jobs: Startup/background catalog sync and enrichment exist, plus on-demand forecasts/KPIs/alerts. No scheduler endpoints or persisted KPI snapshots.
cross_cutting_architecture_gaps.external_services: Qdrant optional for recommendations and swaps; catalog sync depends on it. LLM optional for copilot wording. Missing optional ranking/LLM falls back rather than guaranteeing a particular HTTP error.
cross_cutting_architecture_gaps.business_outcomes: Lower waste, healthier employees and revenue uplift are architecture goals, not verified API response claims.
